findings.summary: AxiosError.from no longer copies the source error's own properties (errno, syscall, address, port, hostname), only message, code and name.
The new `code || error.code` drops a falsy-but-defined code that the old code preserved.
The old default message of 'Error' when none was given is no longer applied.
`cause` is now set by plain assignment, so it is enumerable. It appears in Object.keys, spreads and util.inspect output, and can add circular references.
isAxiosError is now an own enumerable instance property instead of a non-enumerable prototype property. This changes Object.keys, spreads and own-key equality checks.
__CANCEL__ moved from the prototype to an own instance property, so code that checks Object.keys or copies errors may behave differently.
status is now undefined instead of null when the response has no status, which changes toJSON output.
The Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor) call was removed, so stacks now carry extra AxiosError/CanceledError constructor frames.
The new isNativeError tests use require('node:util/types') in what look like ESM spec files and silently pass in non-Node environments. Nothing tests the from() regressions.
AxiosError.js uses 4-space indentation while the rest of lib uses 2 spaces.
